$comment: Fork definition for tooling/skill-sync. Paths are upstream-relative except paths[].output. Anchors and replacements are literal; a list of strings is joined with newlines.
name: autoreview
description: Harness-agnostic structured code review: upstream's autoreview skill without the OpenClaw engine or ClawSweeper hosted-review guidance.

helper-help-text.description: Hide the OpenClaw-only flags from the helper's --help. If it drifts, --help still lists them, but the engine stays refused.

delete.reason: Documents only the OpenClaw engine and its bound sandbox integration, which this fork refuses.
A stub for OpenClaw consumer repositories: it sends readers to the canonical openclaw/agent-skills install and forbids vendored copies, which is the opposite of this repository's setup.
Covers only the OpenClaw engine's direct execution.

rules.reason: The whole section governs requesting ClawSweeper's hosted bot review.

anchor: Consumers keep the [shared-skill entrypoint](references/repository-entrypoint.md)
and local review requirements. Update shared behavior here after active reviews finish.

rules.reason: Links the deleted OpenClaw consumer entrypoint and upstream's install-skills script.

anchor: - For the OpenClaw engine, use [restricted agent execution](references/openclaw.md):
direct CLI on an authenticated host, or the bound `autoreview` tool inside an
OpenClaw sandbox. With no explicit route and no eligible default CLI, use the
bound tool when available. Supply the target and explicitly requested overrides;
the helper owns review defaults, and native OpenClaw supplies configuration and
authentication. The bound integration admits the model under current caller
permissions before execution and reports the effective choice.
rules.reason: Engine bullet for OpenClaw, which this fork refuses (see helper/refuse-openclaw-engine).

- To change it, edit `upstream/autoreview.json` and run `tooling/skill-sync/skill-sync sync autoreview`.
